title: debian: Switch to using scap -> _scap group name for dumpcalls
description:
The practice of starting system groups with "_" improves the chances of not
having a conflicting user group present already on the system.

See full discussion at https://lists.debian.org/debian-devel/2025/10/msg00053.html

notes.body: added this merge request to the [merge train](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_trains) at position 2

commits_data.message:
debian: Switch to using scap -> _scap group name for dumpcalls

The practice of starting system groups with "_" improves the chances of not
having a conflicting user group present already on the system.

See full discussion at https://lists.debian.org/debian-devel/2025/10/msg00053.html
